errors.text: The proposed alloy and thermo-mechanical precipitation route do not reconstruct the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic alloy or its 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT treatment.
The falsification rule incorrectly treats high strength with low ductility in the control as falsification, although that result would support the claim that the complete stepwise route is needed.
